t: Complete spill response kit specifically designed for the safe and efficient clean-up of oil spills, featuring oil-only absorbent socks made with a spunbond outer layer that maximises tensile strength, liquid retention, and durability. Includes oil-only absorbent pads, perforated for controlled usage and manufactured from high-loft meltblown polypropylene fibres, providing excellent absorbency performance and strength. A compact clip-top bag ensures easy storage, handling, and transport, making the kit ideal for use in vehicles, small workshops, confined areas, and equipment cabins. The durable clear bag features bold labelling for quick identification during emergencies, and as a single-use kit, it is designed for immediate deployment when quick response is critical.
